capabilities: color list and formula property values in Bases with hash-based consistent colors
customize colors per value via hex/HSL entry or a visual color picker
toggle coloring independently per property type, including embedded bases
extras: Manual installation only (download from GitHub releases); manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README says development was assisted by GitHub Copilot and Claude Sonnet 4.
intentEvidence: inspired by the excellent Colored Tags plugin by Pavel Frankov
problem: Bases property values and tags render uncolored, so different values are hard to tell apart at a glance.

relations.evidence: inspired by the excellent Colored Tags plugin by Pavel Frankov, which provides similar functionality for tags

summary: Colors property values in Bases views, embedded bases, and markdown, covering list and formula properties plus inline tags.
